rec: Amulet of glory for getting to Osman

st.t: Talk to the High Priest in Sophanem.
s: Sounds like a quest for me; I can't turn that down!
Is there any way into Menaphos from below?

st.t: Talk to Jex in the building in north east Sophanem.
Go down the ladder east of Jex.
Go down the trapdoor.

Be careful of traps, and use protection prayers against the monsters. From the bottom of the trapdoor walk 8 squares south, 5 west, 7 north, 7 west, 2 north, 10 west, 6 south and 3 east to the first break in the path. Disarm the trap there.
Carry on 5 squares east, 4 south, 4 east, 4 south, 13 east and 6 south to the second break. Disarm the trap there.
Carry on 8 squares south, 9 west, 6 north, 7 west, 3 north, 8 west, 4 south, 4 east, 13 south and 2 east to the third break. Disarm the trap there.
Carry on 6 squares east, 5 south, 12 west, 8 south, 12 west, 2 north, 5 west, 1 south, 3 west, 2 north and 8 west to the south west ladder.
Follow the path along, and search Kaleef's corpse there.
Read the parchment
Talk to Maisa on the west side of the chasm.
Talk to Osman in Al Kharid.
s: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
It could drive a wedge between the Menaphite cities.

st.t: Talk to Osman north of Sophanem.
s: I know of a secret entrance to the north.

st.t: Prepare to fight a level 191 Giant Scarab. Go down the ladder east of Jex.
Go down the trapdoor.

Be careful of traps, and use protection prayers against the monsters. From the bottom of the trapdoor walk 8 squares south, 5 west, 7 north, 7 west, 2 north, 10 west, 6 south and 3 east to the first break in the path. Disarm the trap there.
Carry on 5 squares east, 4 south, 4 east, 4 south, 13 east and 6 south to the second break. Disarm the trap there.
Carry on 8 squares south, 9 west, 6 north, 7 west, 3 north, 8 west, 4 south, 4 east, 13 south and 2 east to the third break. Disarm the trap there.
Carry on 6 squares east, 5 south, 12 west, 8 south, 12 west, 2 north, 5 west, 1 south, 3 west, 2 north and 8 west to the south west ladder.
Kill the Giant Scarab near the chasm. It can extinguish your light source and poison you, so be careful. Pray melee if you are meleeing it, range if you are attacking it from a distance.
Talk to Osman in the chasm.
Pick up the Keris.
Report back to the High Priest in Sophanem.
